svg.title: Where SILKern sits in a context-parallel decode step, narrow
svg.desc: The same decode step as the wide figure, stacked for narrow pages. The selector's row t = [8, 5, 130, 7, -1, 262] reaches rank 0 directly and rank 1 along the right margin. Rank 0's SILKern returns [708, 129, 451, -1, -1, -1] with count 3 and rank 1's returns [706, 707, -1, -1, -1, -1] with count 2; each rank's attention gathers from its own KV cache, and the partial terms meet along the left margin to give y = N / Z.
